evidence.detail: rs/l/e constructs a BufferedImage, obtains its backing DataBufferInt int[] and stores width/height alongside that shared pixel array.
Its initialization method passes width, height and the backing int[] directly into rs/l/c DrawingArea initialization.
Its graphics method blits the BufferedImage to an AWT Graphics target at supplied coordinates.

candidates.note: RSImageProducer is the conservative classic-client name for this BufferedImage-backed framebuffer producer; exact v308 behavior is primary authority.

evidence.detail: Client constructs rs/l/h instances for p11_full, p12_full, b12_full and q8_full alongside a separate rs/l/K font set built from p11_full/p12_full/b12_full; this is the client's newer parallel font engine rather than the classic TextDrawingArea slot.
rs/l/h owns glyph masks/metrics plus static Sprite[] icon support and a substantially richer markup/effect text API, including icon-aware width/drawing paths and formatted/tagged rendering.

Public 317-derived clients commonly load classic TextDrawingArea fonts and a second RSFont set side by side from the same p11_full/p12_full/b12_full/q8_full resources; the exact v308 construction pattern matches that split.

candidates.note: RSFont is the conservative historical/semantic name for v308's newer rich-text/icon-aware font engine, distinct from the parallel classic TextDrawingArea implementation.

evidence.detail: rs/l/E owns the large triangle rasterization surface: flat, Gouraud and textured triangle entry points plus scanline helpers operating on the shared framebuffer/depth state.
The class owns texture image arrays, texture caches, HSL/RGB palette state, brightness transforms and average texture colors.
It also owns sine/cosine and reciprocal-style lookup tables consumed by Scene/Model projection and triangle drawing.

candidates.note: Rasterizer3D is the conservative semantic name for the textured/Gouraud triangle engine and its texture/palette/projection state.

evidence.detail: rs/l/F owns image dimensions, offsets and an int[] ARGB/RGB pixel array, with constructors from archive entries, byte arrays, AWT Image objects and named image resources.
Its methods clip, transform, scale, alpha-blend, rotate and draw the pixel array into the shared DrawingArea framebuffer.
It can draw using rs/l/a IndexedImage as a mask, directly linking the full-color Sprite and paletted IndexedImage layers.

candidates.note: Sprite is fixed by the full-color image storage and comprehensive clipped/transformed sprite drawing surface.

evidence.detail: rs/l/a loads sprite-index data from an archive entry plus index.dat, decoding a byte-indexed pixel array, integer palette, dimensions, offsets and storage order.
Drawing methods clip against rs/l/c DrawingArea bounds and copy palette-selected colors into the shared pixel buffer while treating zero palette indices as transparent.
rs/l/E Rasterizer3D stores rs/l/a[] as its texture-image source set, matching the indexed/paletted image role.

candidates.note: IndexedImage is fixed by byte-indexed pixels, integer palette, archive/index.dat decoding and texture/mask consumers.

evidence.detail: rs/l/c owns the global int[] pixel framebuffer plus float[] depth buffer, width/height and clip-bound state; initialization binds caller-supplied pixel/depth arrays.
Its methods clear and clip the buffer and draw/fill rectangles, lines and alpha-blended 2D primitives directly into the framebuffer.
rs/l/h TextDrawingArea extends rs/l/c directly and renders glyph masks into the same pixel buffer, fixing rs/l/c as the shared classic DrawingArea layer.

candidates.note: DrawingArea preserves the classic semantic identity of the shared 2D framebuffer, clipping and primitive-drawing layer.

evidence.detail: rs/l/K stores the canonical classic font state: 256 glyph byte masks, five parallel metric/offset/advance arrays, Random strike-through/effect state and one base-character-height integer.

Its constructor (boolean, String, StreamLoader) reads <font>.dat and index.dat, advances the index stream by the font header offset and decodes all 256 glyph masks/metrics in the classic TextDrawingArea layout.
Client constructs rs/l/K for p11_full, p12_full and b12_full, passes an rs/l/K[] directly into RSInterface loading, and uses the instances for classic chat/interface string measurement and drawing.
Public classic TextDrawingArea source has the same Random field, 256 glyph-mask arrays, six classic metric/advance arrays and identical p11_full/p12_full/b12_full archive construction pattern.

candidates.note: TextDrawingArea is fixed by the exact classic glyph-array/Random/archive-loader shape and by Client's use of this font set for RSInterface and classic UI/chat rendering.
